title: Joint frame compiler: conditional κ = 4.669442391e-5
body:
Conditional exponent saving: **κ = 4.669442391e-5**.

The PR #53 skip-prefix graph can use fewer physical auxiliary roles when each equal-frame region is compiled as one invertible binary map and retired signal components are reclaimed. The resulting conditional witness is:

**κ ≈ 4669442391/10¹⁴ > 2⁻¹⁵** (exactly `4669442391/100000000000000`).

This is **2.6551% above #56**, **2.8283% above #55**, **3.1000% above #54**, and **3.8082% above #53**, comparing their stated conditional exponent savings, not measured runtimes. #56 appeared during submission; its draft reports independent exact recertification still pending. No global optimality claim is made.

| Quantity | PR #53 | This PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| h23 auxiliary roles | 32,946 | **31,416** |
| h25 auxiliary roles | 43,409 | **41,264** |
| Physical wires W | 160,799,739 | **153,481,944** |

The compiler groups scalar nodes with the same original rational envelope, synthesizes joint reversible linear maps, matches compatible retained signals to later uses, and clears retired input-dependent signals with paid XOR gates. Arbitrary old dirty components are retained and canceled by the full compute/scatter/uncompute word. Designated output roles stay distinct; copied centers and endpoint corrections remain charged.

The actual fixed-I+J transition profiles give bit saving `116741511/2500000000000`. The 4,073,300 data pairs, rank deficit 1,846,900, maximum child width 529, complex branch, and balanced assembly interfaces remain inherited.

### Reproduce

```sh
make skip-frame-verify
make verify
```

Start with `scripts/experiments/skip_frame_README.txt`, `skip_frame_compiler.py`, and `certificates/skip-frame-kappa.json`. The README includes the finite mechanism and remaining proof dependencies.

**Focused verification passed on this publication branch:** complete input/dirty basis in both orientations; independent reconstruction of every frame transition from the serialized XOR word; all 60,989 / 81,960 distinct fixed-basis matrices, including 6,373 / 8,518 CRT checks with zero disagreements; exact rational recurrence; all 47 strict assembly inequalities, seven margins, and eventual cutoff arithmetic. Both producer words were separately regenerated and matched the saved words byte for byte after decompression.

**Full repository `make verify` passed** at construction commit `cd350f76c9bc01489ec83568bded532cb69be938`: **246 integrated unit tests**, the retained 12/10/17/5-test focused suites, **all 20 historical patch checks**, the complete new auxiliary replay, and inherited PR48/49 producer/data checks covering all **4,073,300 data pairs**, including the ten exact primary-prime recoveries. The tracked worktree was clean afterward. [Validation receipt](https://github.com/eumemic/integer-mult-bounds/blob/codex/skip-frame-compiler/certificates/skip-frame-repository-validation.json); log SHA256 `e7d271e0db1530e2c26a157b114ad46cacc19c5e476eca6e37e909b2e766bf33`. The subsequent commit only adds this receipt. The focused command alone inherits the unchanged data calculation; the full suite replayed it. No Lean build is claimed.

The result remains conditional on the inherited all-size residual compiler, fixed finite-alphabet multitape, analytic, routing, and recovery interfaces. Finite checks are not formal verification or external acceptance of the complete multiplication theorem. No manuscript or PDF is added.
